lines.en: label karinsummer2morninggen:
scene karinsummer2morninggen
I have to call Karin three separate times in order to make plans with her after she accidentally got nervous and hung up on the first two attempts.
lines.zh: 我给 Karin 打了三次电话才约成——前两次她一紧张，不小心就把电话挂了。

lines.en: But once she remembers how to speak and that I am not just an evil penis-bearing entity, the two of us make plans to meet up at a diner near her house for coffee and breakfast.
lines.zh: 不过等她想起该怎么说话、想起我并不是什么长着鸡巴的邪恶生物之后，我们约在她家附近的一家小餐馆见面，喝咖啡吃早餐。

lines.en: What she did not inform me at the time of making these plans is that she already {i}ate{/i} breakfast and that she wanted to suggest something else, but didn’t want to disappoint me.
lines.zh: 约的时候她没告诉我，她其实已经{i}吃{/i}过早餐了，本来想提议别的，但又不想让我失望。

lines.en: She orders food regardless so she can take it home to Kirin and I awkwardly sit there and eat while she just...watches me.
lines.zh: 她还是点了吃的，好打包带回家给 Kirin，而我尴尬地坐在那里吃，她就那么……看着我。

lines.en: But hey, at least she’s watching me in admiration and not hesitance or suspicion like she used to.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，至少她现在看我的眼神是带着仰慕，不再像从前那样犹豫和怀疑。

lines.en: Even {i}if{/i} she’s still struggling to talk normally around me, I know that she’s gotten a lot better and that {i}we{/i} have gotten a lot closer.
lines.zh: {i}虽然{/i}她在我面前还是很难正常说话，但我知道她已经好多了，{i}我们{/i}也亲近多了。

lines.en: scene black
There’s still much room to go, though.
lines.zh: 不过，还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: Just being the only man in her life apart from her father is not enough to sate my appetite.
lines.zh: 光是成为她生命里除父亲之外唯一的男人，还填不饱我的胃口。

lines.en: I don’t care how many breakfasts I must eat alone or how many rice balls she’ll stuff into to-go boxes.
lines.zh: 我不在乎要独自吃多少顿早餐，也不在乎她往打包盒里塞多少饭团。

lines.en: I will take what I want for-
: Um...S-Sensei?
: You look...I don’t know...different?
lines.zh: : 你看起来……怎么说呢……不太一样？

lines.en: : Is everything okay?
I stare down at a plate still full of food and a half-empty cup of coffee-
lines.zh: 我低头盯着一盘子还没怎么动过的食物和半空的咖啡杯——

lines.en: And suddenly feel full.
$ karin_love += 1
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
jump saturdayafternoon
